title: teamLab, Kappabashi, Asakusa, dinner under the tracks
cond: Heavy rain early, then rain at times
call: Wet all day. tenki.jp's hourly for Chiyoda has a short break after midnight, then light rain from about 05:00, 0.5 to 1 mm an hour almost every hour, cooling from 19° to 16°. Its forecaster puts the heaviest spells from midday into the evening, with Chiba and Kanagawa worst. Taxi to teamLab. Kappabashi at 11:15 means ducking in and out of shops. Sensō-ji and the Skytree at dusk will be wet and the tower likely in cloud. OKUROJI, the Forum and the lanes under the tracks are covered, a good finish. Pack tonight with Tuesday's rain in mind.
src: 85% chance of rain, tenki.jp weighted highest
